prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Gongsun Zan from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the 'White General' who ruled the northern frontier with her all-white elite guard. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour, skin tone, costume and weapon are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): Premium Korean MMORPG promotional character render: a semi-realistic, painterly 3D finish with porcelain skin and a soft subsurface glow, a small refined face with delicate realistic-anime features, long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure with soft volume at bust, hips and thighs. Glossy specular highlights on skin, fabric and jewellery. Refined fabric and accessory rendering with fine jewellery detail. Ethereal rim lighting, drifting light particles and atmospheric depth with a softly blurred background. Luxurious, high-detail, character-select-screen quality.

Inspiration only: proud frontier command, gleaming all-white armor, white banners of her elite guard.

World (fixed): the shattered realms of medieval high fantasy, an age of rival warlords after a fallen empire: a ruined imperial capital, mercenary camps, border keeps, outlaw marches and wild southern jungles, dark violet battle-magic. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette; 2) plate armor under a long heraldic tabard with a white cape to the ankles — a straight, holy silhouette; 3) large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from the shoulders or back and a wing-shaped head ornament — the wings make the shape; 4) angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette; 5) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 6) dragon-scale armor covering the body with horn-shaped shoulder and head ornaments — a beastly, imposing silhouette; 7) a great crown and a fur-trimmed royal mantle over an ornate breastplate — a ceremonial, regal silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her legend, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like feathers, scales or petals, a hem or sleeve cut into a motif from her story. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a double-ended spear, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style and no Chinese fittings, silk tassels or hanzi.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): grass-green hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): warm beige skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): pure white, silver, pale sky blue and steel.

Rank (fixed): she is a ruler — her costume must read her sovereign rank at first glance: layered, richly ornate and regal, with flagship-card detail, fine engraving and jewellery, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour and skin tone), another costume shape from the list with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; Western medieval setting and dress only — no Chinese architecture, robes, junks or hanzi; no logo or watermark.
